document: An admission ticket to an event (a match or a concert) with the event, its time and place, the ticket holder and the holder's seat
glossary: Document type: An admission ticket to an event (a match or a concert) with the event, its time and place, the ticket holder and the holder's seat. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.ticket_id: the ticket's own identifier, the number printed as its id (azonosító)
field_specs.holder_name: the name of the person the ticket is issued to (név)
field_specs.event_name: the event the ticket admits to, as printed: the match's two teams with the dash between them, or the concert's title (mérkőzés, meccs, párharc, párosítás)
field_specs.event_datetime: the event's date and starting time, written as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (időpont, dátum és idő)
field_specs.venue: the name of the stadium, arena or hall where the event is held, as printed (helyszín); not its address
field_specs.birth_place: the ticket holder's place of birth (születési hely)
field_specs.birth_date: the ticket holder's date of birth (születési idő)
field_specs.card_number: the number of the holder's club or fan card printed on the ticket (kártyaszám)
field_specs.gate: the entrance gate exactly as printed in the ticket's gate field (Kapu/Gate), with every word and gate number of that field, not only its first part
field_specs.sector: the sector as printed in the ticket's sector field (Szektor/Sector), with its mark and the word that follows the mark
field_specs.row: the row number within the sector (Sor/Row)
field_specs.seat: the seat number within the row (Szék/Seat)
